module_summary: Source-synchronous SDR output: registers data in an IOB flip-flop and forwards an inverted-phase clock through a DDR output register instance.

anchors.name: output_q_reg
anchors.why: IOB output register capturing input_d each clock, drives output_q.

anchors.name: input_d
anchors.why: Input data registered into the IOB output flip-flop.

anchors.name: output_clk
anchors.why: Forwarded clock generated by ODDR with constant d1=0, d2=1.

anchors.name: output_q
anchors.why: Registered output data aligned with forwarded clock.

groups.name: data_output_register
groups.description: IOB flip-flop registering data onto the output pins.

groups.name: clock_forwarding
groups.description: ODDR instance generating the source-synchronous output clock.
